findings.explanation: Your indemnification obligations are excluded from the overall liability cap, exposing you to unlimited financial liability for indemnified claims.
findings.suggested_change: Each Party's maximum liability in any way related to this Agreement, including any indemnification obligations, shall not exceed $2,000,000.00 (excluding any amounts due and payable pursuant to Section 8 hereunder).

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. Before I sign, I would like to request the following adjustment: - Regarding the relevant clause, the agreement excludes indemnification obligations from the overall liability cap, which exposes us to unlimited financial liability. We propose updating this so that each party's maximum liability, including any indemnification obligations, does not exceed $2,000,000.00, excluding amounts due under Section 8. Please let me know if this works for you so we can move forward. Best regards
